name: Amagiri Kyuuju
source: The first of [url=/c14792]Kazama[/url]'s attendants, who always follows behind him and has a calm, composed personality. Although he is not really of an age to be a high school student, he was forcibly made to accompany Kazama when he re-entered high school.
